works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 保险代理网站设计：主标题“We cover your home.”配房屋照片主视觉，副文案“One platform. Every kind of coverage.”，下方 2,300+ families covered、$1M term、20 years 三组数字镇场；保险网站用“一句口语化承诺 + 三组可信数字”把保障讲得不像推销。
works.comment_en: An insurance agency site: the headline "We cover your home." sits over a house photograph, backed by "One platform. Every kind of coverage." and three trust numbers — 2,300+ families covered, a $1M term, 20 years; insurance sold with one plain-spoken promise plus three credible figures, not a sales pitch.
works.title: Insurance Agency Website Design & Animation

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: 空气净化器产品站 Sere：主标题“Meet Sere”配“CLEAN AIR / LESS WORRY”，白色机身立在雾气苔藓景观里，标注 45%；产品站用“一台机器 + 一片雾气森林”把净化效果做成可感知的画面。
works.comment_en: Sere, an air purifier product site: "Meet Sere" and "CLEAN AIR / LESS WORRY" frame a white purifier standing in a misty moss landscape, marked 45%; a product page turns filtration into something you can feel with one machine and one foggy forest.
works.title: Sere — Air Purifier Product Website Animation

works.author: George Railean
works.comment: 地理空间情报仪表盘：深色任务控制界面配地球仪主视觉，Kestrel 智能体调度卫星与无人机任务，界面只用单一青色点缀；情报仪表盘用“一个地球仪 + 一个青色”把复杂的任务调度收成一屏可读的指挥台。
works.comment_en: A geospatial intelligence dashboard: a dark mission-control view centers on a globe while the Kestrel agent schedules satellite and drone missions, with a single cyan accent throughout; a complex operations picture reads as one command screen thanks to one globe and one accent color.
works.title: Geospatial Intelligence Dashboard & Mission Control UI

works.author: SlabPixel Designer for SlabPixel
works.comment: AI SaaS 自动化网站 Nexus 支撑页：深色 Bento 网格配玻璃质感卡片，定价 $0 / $49 / $149 per month 一字排开，首月 $30 加优惠码 DISKON90；支撑页用“Bento 网格 + 三档定价”把功能与价格一次摊开讲清。
works.comment_en: Nexus, an AI SaaS and automation supporting page: a dark Bento grid of glassy cards lays out pricing at $0 / $49 / $149 per month, with a $30 first month and the DISKON90 code; a supporting page gets features and pricing across in one glance with a Bento grid and three clear tiers.
works.title: AI SaaS & Automation Website Supporting Page — Nexus

works.author: tubik
works.comment: 金融科技 SaaS 网站：哥特拱门 3D 主视觉配主标题“Get Paid ON EVERY Invoice”，文案“Factura's agent drafts, chases and matches payments within your limits”，配 Request beta 入口；收款工具用“一座拱门 + 一句每张发票都收钱”把催款这件苦差讲得有气势。
works.comment_en: A fintech SaaS site: a gothic-arch 3D hero carries "Get Paid ON EVERY Invoice", with "Factura's agent drafts, chases and matches payments within your limits" and a Request beta button; chasing payments gets grandeur from one arch and one promise that every invoice gets paid.
works.title: Fintech SaaS Website with 3D Hero

works.author: Ronald Olsen for Awsmd
works.comment: 加密钱包 App：紫色玻璃质感发送界面，“You're sending $1,680.00 to @mariebrown”，Network Fee $1.00、Total $1,679，底部 Swap to Confirm；转账界面用“一个金额 + 一次滑动确认”把付钱的动作做得又轻又确定。
works.comment_en: A crypto wallet app: a purple glass send screen reads "You're sending $1,680.00 to @mariebrown" with a $1.00 network fee and $1,679 total, closed by Swap to Confirm; sending money feels light yet certain with one amount and one swipe to confirm.
works.title: Crypto Wallet UI

works.author: Royhan ® for One Week Wonders
works.comment: 护肤品落地页 Moosë：主标题“A Magic Spray for Skin Problems”，Day 0 / Day 14 前后对比滑块配“One Molecule. Endless application”，标注 0%、3 sec、7 days；护肤落地页用“一个对比滑块 + 三组功效数字”让一瓶喷雾的效果看得见。
works.comment_en: Moosë, a skincare landing page: "A Magic Spray for Skin Problems" leads into a Day 0 / Day 14 before-after slider and "One Molecule. Endless application", marked 0%, 3 sec, 7 days; one spray's effect becomes visible through a comparison slider and three efficacy numbers.
works.title: Moosë - Skincare Landing Page

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 无代码建站 VibeBuild：紫色渐变落地页，主标题“Launch apps without code”，Describe / AI builds / Publish 三步流程，模板画廊后接 Stripe、Supabase、Notion、Claude、Gemini 集成；无代码工具用“三步流程 + 一排集成 logo”把“说句话就能上线”讲得可信。
works.comment_en: VibeBuild, an AI no-code landing page: a purple-gradient hero promises "Launch apps without code" in three steps — Describe, AI builds, Publish — followed by a template gallery and Stripe, Supabase, Notion, Claude and Gemini integrations; "describe it and ship it" reads as credible with a three-step flow and a row of integration logos.
works.title: Launch apps without code | AI No-Code Landing Page

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 邮件营销自动化 App：Campaign Journey Builder 配 September Product Education 活动，Audience 18,420、14,736 reconnectable、+3,684 reachable，状态栏“Ready to send，Checks passed”；营销工具用“一组受众数字 + 一个就绪状态”让发信前的心里有底。
works.comment_en: An email marketing automation app: a Campaign Journey Builder runs the September Product Education campaign with an audience of 18,420 — 14,736 reconnectable, +3,684 reachable — and a status bar reading "Ready to send, Checks passed"; sending feels safe with one set of audience numbers and one green-light status.
works.title: Email Marketing Automation Web App Design
